sentences.text: Applicant :- Arjun Sharma

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Anand Prakash Srivastava,Sugendra Kumar Yadav Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mayank Kumar Jain,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. Sri S.K. Ojha for the State-respondent,
learned counsel for the informant and perused the record.

The present bail application has been filed on behalf of applicant in Case Crime No. 373 of 2020,
under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506, 376, 511 IPC and section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Sigra,
District Varanasi with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
It is argued by the learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is father-in-law (60 years) of the informant and he has been falsely implicated in the present case.

He further argued that son of applicant namely, Ravi Prakash, who is husband of informant Sandhya Sharma filed a divorce petition before the Principal Judge, Family Court, Deoria on 02.07.2020 against the informant and thereafter, as a counter blast, present first information report has been lodged by the informant against the applicant.
The marriage of informant was solemnized with the son of applicant on 05.05.2018 and no demand of dowry was ever made by the applicant and his family members and he never treated with cruelty.
He further argued that informant refused to go for medical examination.
Independent witness Smt. Mandodra Devi, who is neighbour of the informant has denied such allegation for committing rape by the applicant.

There are material contradictions in Arjun Sharma vs State Of U.P. on 15 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/65182042/
1 the statement of victim under section 161 and 164 Cr. P.C.

entities.text: Arjun Sharma vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is also submitted that no such incident is described in the first information report.

It is further submitted that applicant is languishing in jail since 02.08.2022 having no criminal history and that in case he is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will cooperate in trial.

Per contra, the learned Additional Government Advocate has opposed the prayer for grant of bail and submits that victim in her statement under section 161 and 164 Cr. P.C. has made allegation against the applicant.

Considering the entire facts and circumstances of the case, submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of evidence and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant Arjun Sharma in the aforesaid crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties to the satisfaction of court concerned subject to the following conditions:
(1). The applicant will not tamper with the prosecution evidence during the trial.
(2). The applicant will not influence any witness.
(3). The applicant will appear before the trial Court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

(4). The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move an application before this Court seeking cancellation of the bail.

Order Date :- 15.2.2023 T.S.
